spec.description: SMB Client Performance — displays performance of SMB connections to network shares including IOPS, latency, and data volume metrics. Converted from Splunk uberAgent dashboard.

spec.title: IOPS over time per network share (top [[TopN]])
spec.description: Stacked IOPS (read+write) over time for the top [[TopN]] shares by total IOPS. Aggregation controlled by the IOPS function variable.

spec.query:
let top5shares = System_SmbClient
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where ("${host}" == "All" or Host == "${host}")
| where isnotempty(SharePath)
| summarize TotalIOPS = sum(IOPSRead + IOPSWrite) by SharePath
| top [[TopN]] by TotalIOPS desc
| project SharePath;

System_SmbClient
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where ("${host}" == "All" or Host == "${host}")
| where SharePath in (top5shares)
| summarize
    avg_iops = round(avg(IOPSRead + IOPSWrite), 1),
    min_iops = round(min(IOPSRead + IOPSWrite), 1),
    max_iops = round(max(IOPSRead + IOPSWrite), 1),
    sum_iops = round(sum(IOPSRead + IOPSWrite), 1)
  by bin(Timestamp, $__interval), SharePath
| extend IOPS = iff("${iops_function}" == "min", min_iops, iff("${iops_function}" == "max", max_iops, avg_iops))
| project Timestamp, SharePath, IOPS
| order by Timestamp asc

System_SmbClient
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where ("${host}" == "All" or Host == "${host}")
| summarize
    ReadVolumeMB = round(sum(IOMBRead), 1),
    WriteVolumeMB = round(sum(IOMBWrite), 1),
    TotalMB = round(sum(IOMBRead) + sum(IOMBWrite), 1)
  by SharePath
| top [[TopN]] by TotalMB desc
| project SharePath, ReadVolumeMB, WriteVolumeMB

System_SmbClient
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where ("${host}" == "All" or Host == "${host}")
| summarize
    SumDurRead = sum(IOLatencyMsRead), SumCountRead = sum(IOCountRead),
    SumDurWrite = sum(IOLatencyMsWrite), SumCountWrite = sum(IOCountWrite),
    SumDurRW = sum(IOLatencyMsRead) + sum(IOLatencyMsWrite),
    SumCountRW = sum(IOCountRead) + sum(IOCountWrite)
  by SharePath
| extend
    AvgReadLatencyMs = round(iff(SumCountRead > 0, SumDurRead / SumCountRead, 0.0), 1),
    AvgWriteLatencyMs = round(iff(SumCountWrite > 0, SumDurWrite / SumCountWrite, 0.0), 1),
    AvgRWLatencyMs = round(iff(SumCountRW > 0, SumDurRW / SumCountRW, 0.0), 1)
| top [[TopN]] by AvgRWLatencyMs desc
| project SharePath, AvgReadLatencyMs, AvgWriteLatencyMs

System_SmbClient
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where ("${host}" == "All" or Host == "${host}")
| summarize
    ReadVolumeMB = round(sum(IOMBRead), 1),
    WriteVolumeMB = round(sum(IOMBWrite), 1)
  by bin(Timestamp, $__interval)

System_SmbClient
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where ("${host}" == "All" or Host == "${host}")
| summarize
    SumDurRead = sum(IOLatencyMsRead), SumCountRead = sum(IOCountRead),
    SumDurWrite = sum(IOLatencyMsWrite), SumCountWrite = sum(IOCountWrite)
  by bin(Timestamp, $__interval)
| extend
    AvgReadLatencyMs = round(iff(SumCountRead > 0, SumDurRead / SumCountRead, 0.0), 1),
    AvgWriteLatencyMs = round(iff(SumCountWrite > 0, SumDurWrite / SumCountWrite, 0.0), 1)
| project Timestamp, AvgReadLatencyMs, AvgWriteLatencyMs

spec.title: Data table
spec.description: SMB client performance detail. Use the Group by and IOPS function variables to change the view. Latency columns have gauge-style cells with green/yellow/red thresholds at 5ms and 20ms.

spec.query:
System_SmbClient
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where ("${host}" == "All" or Host == "${host}")
| summarize
    ReadIOCount = sum(IOCountRead),
    WriteIOCount = sum(IOCountWrite),
    MetadataIOCount = sum(IOCountMetadata),
    SumDurRead = sum(IOLatencyMsRead),
    SumDurWrite = sum(IOLatencyMsWrite),
    SumIOMBRead = sum(IOMBRead),
    SumIOMBWrite = sum(IOMBWrite),
    avg_iops_read = round(avg(IOPSRead), 1), min_iops_read = round(min(IOPSRead), 1), max_iops_read = round(max(IOPSRead), 1),
    avg_iops_write = round(avg(IOPSWrite), 1), min_iops_write = round(min(IOPSWrite), 1), max_iops_write = round(max(IOPSWrite), 1),
    avg_iops_meta = round(avg(IOPSMetadata), 1), min_iops_meta = round(min(IOPSMetadata), 1), max_iops_meta = round(max(IOPSMetadata), 1),
    ShareCount = dcount(SharePath),
    HostCount = dcount(Host)
  by SharePath
| extend
    AvgReadLatencyMs = round(iff(ReadIOCount > 0, SumDurRead / ReadIOCount, 0.0), 1),
    AvgWriteLatencyMs = round(iff(WriteIOCount > 0, SumDurWrite / WriteIOCount, 0.0), 1),
    IOPSRead = iff("${iops_function}" == "min", min_iops_read, iff("${iops_function}" == "max", max_iops_read, avg_iops_read)),
    IOPSWrite = iff("${iops_function}" == "min", min_iops_write, iff("${iops_function}" == "max", max_iops_write, avg_iops_write)),
    IOPSMetadata = iff("${iops_function}" == "min", min_iops_meta, iff("${iops_function}" == "max", max_iops_meta, avg_iops_meta)),
    ReadVolumeMB = round(SumIOMBRead, 1),
    WriteVolumeMB = round(SumIOMBWrite, 1)
| project SharePath, ReadIOCount, WriteIOCount, MetadataIOCount, AvgReadLatencyMs, AvgWriteLatencyMs, IOPSRead, IOPSWrite, IOPSMetadata, ReadVolumeMB, WriteVolumeMB, ShareCount, HostCount
| order by SharePath asc

System_SmbClient
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where ("${host}" == "All" or Host == "${host}")
| summarize
    ReadVolumeMB = round(sum(IOMBRead), 1),
    WriteVolumeMB = round(sum(IOMBWrite), 1),
    TotalMB = round(sum(IOMBRead) + sum(IOMBWrite), 1)
  by Host
| top [[TopN]] by TotalMB desc
| project Host, ReadVolumeMB, WriteVolumeMB

System_SmbClient
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where ("${host}" == "All" or Host == "${host}")
| where isnotnull(IOLatencyMsRead)
| summarize 
    WeightedLatency = sum(IOLatencyMsRead * IOCountRead),
    TotalOps = sum(IOCountRead)
| extend Value = round(iff(TotalOps > 0, WeightedLatency / TotalOps, 0.0), 1)
| project Value

System_SmbClient
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where ("${host}" == "All" or Host == "${host}")
| summarize
    SumDurRead = sum(IOLatencyMsRead), SumCountRead = sum(IOCountRead),
    SumDurWrite = sum(IOLatencyMsWrite), SumCountWrite = sum(IOCountWrite),
    SumDurRW = sum(IOLatencyMsRead) + sum(IOLatencyMsWrite),
    SumCountRW = sum(IOCountRead) + sum(IOCountWrite)
  by Host
| extend
    AvgReadLatencyMs = round(iff(SumCountRead > 0, SumDurRead / SumCountRead, 0.0), 1),
    AvgWriteLatencyMs = round(iff(SumCountWrite > 0, SumDurWrite / SumCountWrite, 0.0), 1),
    AvgRWLatencyMs = round(iff(SumCountRW > 0, SumDurRW / SumCountRW, 0.0), 1)
| top [[TopN]] by AvgRWLatencyMs desc
| project Host, AvgReadLatencyMs, AvgWriteLatencyMs
